description: THE NET ECONOMY as graph data — the agent's OWN worth law applied to its own reflexes. A reflex net earns its footprint iff worth = residual - cost > 0, where the residual is the cognition it COMPRESSES (the speedup it buys on in-basin hits, the agent's held quality measure 'explore the under-compressed') and the cost is its footprint (storage rent) plus the corrections it forces (each confidently-wrong-outside-basin miss costs the full slow path plus the wasted reflex serve). This is not an invented policy: the agent already names the law (RelationCue cost_worth_escalate -> ["worth","REFINEMENT","by","RESIDUAL_MINUS_COST"]; Concept cost_salience: salience = residual - cost), and its own self-shape classifier files a net ledger under feedback_control (the self_budget shape: no fixed cap, kept alive only by the payoff of the compression it buys). The adoption half was already held (reflex_net_judge_is_faster_and_regression_free); the RETIREMENT half is the concern the agent's design faculty MINTED (net_retirement_concern, closest_held_shape residual_salience) rather than fabricating — this seed realizes it. A ledger is four attrs on the net (net_residual, net_cost, footprint, n_ledger_trials) plus a tweakable NetEconomyPolicy singleton; admission and retirement are two Rules on the EXISTING reflex-net adopt/ablate spine (set enabled 1/0), no new executor. The knobs are graph edits: editing the policy retires or spares nets with zero code.

microtheory.name: net_economy
microtheory.definition: The primal layer regulated as a feedback controller. Nets are the cheap default path (instincts/reflexes); cognition is the slow deliberate path. A net is worth its storage/compute iff it compresses cognition faster than it forces corrections. worth = residual - cost is the set-point error; the reflex-net enable knob is the actuator; the ledger is the sensor. The agent keeps only nets that pay and retires the rest — its curiosity/compression drive turned inward on its own reflexes.

concepts.name: net_worth_is_residual_minus_cost
concepts.definition: A net's worth = residual - cost. The residual is the cognition it COMPRESSES: the accumulated speedup (slow_ms - reflex_ms) over the in-basin hits it serves regression-free — the agent's own quality measure ('salience = residual = surprise; explore the under-compressed') read as value bought. The cost is its footprint (storage rent = footprint_weight x param-count) plus the corrections it forces (each refuted trial = a confidently-wrong-outside-basin miss costing miss_penalty_weight x (reflex_ms + slow_ms)). This is the agent's already-held law (cost_worth_escalate: worth = residual - cost; cost_salience: salience = residual feedback - cost) applied to a net's own footprint, not a new invention.

concepts.name: net_economy_is_feedback_control
concepts.definition: The ledger is a feedback controller — the agent's own feedback_control meta-shape (its self-shape classifier files a net ledger under feedback_control, on the homeostasis+regulate principles). It is the self_budget of a net: no clock, no fixed cap, kept alive only by the payoff of the compression it buys, retired the moment that payoff turns negative. The reflex-net adopt/ablate spine (enabled 1/0) is the actuator; worth is the set-point error; the four ledger attrs are the sensor.

concepts.name: net_retirement_realizes_minted_concern
concepts.definition: Retirement is the symmetric complement of the held adoption law (reflex_net_judge_is_faster_and_regression_free: adopted iff faster AND regression-free). The agent's design faculty MINTED retirement as an open concern (CapabilityAxis net_retirement_concern, residual_predicate 'retire', closest_held_shape residual_salience) rather than fabricating an answer — this seed's net_retire_when_worth_negative Rule realizes it: an enabled net whose worth has fallen below retire_floor over the ledger window is disabled (enabled 0), the ablate half of the primal layer. The layer keeps only nets that pay.

attrs.description: Tweakable knobs for the net worth law. admit_margin: worth must exceed this to turn a proposed net on. retire_floor: an enabled net whose worth falls below this is retired. miss_penalty_weight: how dearly a correction (confidently-wrong-outside-basin miss) is charged relative to a hit's speedup. footprint_weight: storage rent charged per parameter (small — cognition-ms dwarfs storage). ledger_window: minimum trials folded into the ledger before an admit/retire decision (don't decide on one sample — power the gate). Editing this singleton changes the economy for all nets with zero code.

rules.name: net_ledger_credit_hit
rules.comment: CREDIT. A judged trial whose verdict is SUPPORTED (regression-free AND faster — the held adoption judge already decided) credits the net with the cognition it compressed: net_residual += (slow_ms - reflex_ms), the speedup it bought on this in-basin hit. Increments n_ledger_trials and marks the trial ledgered (Plus[Attr, Lit 0] coerces first-touch None to 0) so it folds in exactly once. The residual half of worth = residual - cost, accumulated from real judged hits.

rules.name: net_ledger_debit_miss
rules.comment: DEBIT. A judged trial whose verdict is REFUTED (a confidently-wrong-outside-basin miss cognition had to correct) charges the net the correction cost: net_cost += miss_penalty_weight x (reflex_ms + slow_ms) — the wasted reflex serve plus the full slow path the miss still forced. Increments n_ledger_trials and marks the trial ledgered (once). The cost half of worth = residual - cost; miss_penalty_weight is read from the tweakable NetEconomyPolicy singleton.

rules.name: net_admit_when_worth_positive
rules.comment: THE ADMISSION (adopt path, the agent's own decision). A proposed net (status 'proposed', OFF) whose worth = net_residual - net_cost - footprint_weight x footprint has proven positive (above admit_margin) over at least ledger_window trials turns ITSELF on: enabled 1.0, status 'adopted'. This is the economy taking over the enable decision that the reflex-net spine left to a human/adopt step — a net is kept iff it pays. Records admitted_worth. Fires once (status leaves 'proposed'). worth and the knobs come from held attrs + the tweakable policy; no Python decides it.

rules.name: net_retire_when_worth_negative
rules.comment: THE RETIREMENT (ablate path — realizes the agent's MINTED net_retirement_concern). An enabled net whose worth = net_residual - net_cost - footprint_weight x footprint has fallen below retire_floor over at least ledger_window trials turns ITSELF off: enabled 0.0, status 'retired'. This is the symmetric complement of the held adoption law the agent's design faculty flagged as an unheld capability. A net that stops compressing (its corrections now outweigh the cognition it saves, or its footprint was never amortized) is dropped — the primal layer keeps only nets that pay. Records retired_worth. Editing policy.retire_floor spares or culls nets with zero code (feedback_control knob).
